block.title: In-game pixel sprite sheet: magma cone eruptions, ember wisp flames, lava droplet effects on flat navy
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art, flat colored pixel sprites with bold dark navy outlines and simple two-tone dithered shading, arranged as a clean sprite sheet on a completely flat deep-navy background, no scenery, no glow bleeding into the background, no text, no labels, no UI. Organized in horizontal bands: top band — a squat volcanic MAGMA CONE turret in five states: sealed cone of stacked black basalt plates with cold gray seams, first crack glowing cherry, crater opening with tangerine light, full eruption with a short orange flame cap, and a spent cone puffing gray smoke. Middle band — an EMBER WISP in six frames: a small feral flame, molten-gold round core with ragged orange-red tongues and a thin sparking tail, the flame body licking and bending differently each frame, plus two tiny variants of half and quarter size. Bottom band — projectile and effect pixels: round bullets with bright cores and dark rims in pink and red, a fan of three molten shot, single falling lava droplets with gold spark trails, and four small orange-to-red explosion puffs in growth order from spark to bloom. Chunky readable silhouettes, saturated limited palette, deep-navy backgrounds lifted from black, every sprite facing left, crisp pixel-grid edges.
